cases: A published manager cannot gain publish authority by editing the draft; the owner publish command leaves the artifact unchanged, while an authorized publish commits.
A revoked published identity link cannot publish or activate a version.
A publisher without current management authority is denied.
Only an explicit bootstrap actor may publish when no version is active.
Activation rejects an empty version or one that would remove the publisher/manager.

limits: Focused tests exercise the current publication authority and continuity helpers plus existing governance store/API tests; they do not prove a full management browser request, producer database commit, AI-PDM consumer or Production behavior.
No source merge, Production release, database mutation or traffic change occurred.
